summary: Observability 2: persistent, structured, run-correlated logs (no overwrite on restart) and full command output per run
description:
Owner ask 2026-11-04.

**Today:**

* `run-api.cmd` redirects with `>`, so `api-8000.log` and `.err.log` are **overwritten on every restart** and yesterday's evidence is gone.
* Logs are plain text with no run id.
* Sandbox command output is kept only as a tail (`output_tail`) in the event.

**Want:**

* JSON lines logging (`logging` + a small formatter) with `run_id`, `session_id`, `agent` and `event` on every record, via a contextvar set by the executor.
* Daily-rotated files under `logs/` (gitignored), kept 14 days; the console stays human-readable.
* Full output of every sandbox command written to `private/runs/<run_id>/commands/<seq>.log` (host-side, gitignored), with the event linking to it.
* The Jira intake loop and the executor log state changes once, not every poll (pairs with ANVIL-81).

**Acceptance:**

* restarting the API keeps earlier logs;
* `grep <run_id> logs/*.jsonl` shows that run's whole story;
* a failing command's full output is on disk.

comments.body: [devin] PR #83 up: https://github.com/vishal7pandey/anvil/pull/83 — JSONLFormatter + contextvar (run_id/session_id/agent) set per run; TimedRotatingFileHandler logs/api.jsonl daily, 14 days; console unchanged. record_commands wraps sandbox.execute: full output to private/runs/<run_id>/commands/NNNN.log with a run-tagged link line. run-api.cmd now appends (>>). run.status transitions logged once. 3 tests green.
